subject: Post-demo follow-up: token economics, budget window & trial credit request
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brightbyte.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@brightbyte.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: usage profile & budget range (BrightByte <> Redwood)

Thanks again for the demo this morning — it was helpful to see the latency and KV-cache flow. Quick recap from our side and the asks so we can move the pilot forward.

Summary of what we discussed
- Pilot scope: Generate + rerank pipeline for customer chat assistant (LLM inference + embeddings for context).
- Expected peak: ~1M generated tokens/day for week 1, ramp to ~2M/day in week 3 if metrics look good.
- Projected steady-state: approx 30–50M generated tokens/month depending on rollout speed.

Budget / unit economics
- Our internal target: $/1M tokens between $350–$500 for the hosted model tier (we may accept higher for lower-latency model variants if FRTs are <400ms).
- Procurement has an initial budget window of ~$30k–$50k for a 3 month POC (inclusive of any one-off setup).

Trial credits & timing
- We need a credit top-up to cover the first 2 weeks of load (current free trial will not be sufficient if we ramp).
- Can you confirm a proposed $/1M token figure for the model we saw, and whether Redwood can extend the trial + issue additional credits?

Attachments: BrightByte-MAA-usage-projection.xlsx (projected token curve, day-by-day)

Next steps for us: If you can confirm price band and a short-term credit commitment we’ll confirm a kickoff date and provide PII/FF data sheets for security screening.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Lee
Head of ML, BrightByte

On Sun, Apr 18, 2027 at 09:12 AM BrightByte wrote:
> (attached projection)
From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brightbyte.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: usage profile & budget range (BrightByte <> Redwood)

Hi Hannah — great to meet you and the team earlier. Appreciate the detailed projection; that helps a lot. Short answers below and a proposed immediate path to unblock the pilot.

Pricing & unit economics (ballpark)
- Hosted API, standard gen model we demoed: $400 / 1M generated tokens (this is the typical list for that performance tier).
- If you need the lower-latency model variant (our latency-optimized profile with higher vCPU and fewer quantization steps), list is closer to $650 / 1M — we can discuss blended pricing for the pilot.
- For volumes in your projected band (30–50M/mo) we normally talk committed tiers which drop the unit cost (20–30% off list depending on term).

Trial credit recommendation
- Short-term: we can provision trial credits to cover an accelerated ramp. My initial suggested top-up would be $5,000 to get you through the next 10–14 days of testing while we finalize procurement terms.
- If you plan to spike to 2M/day for a full week, that could push consumption beyond $5k depending on model choice; see projection in the spreadsheet.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) I’ll route a credit request for $5k while we confirm final pricing and volume commitments.
2) Can procurement share an expected PO cadence and target decision date? (procurement@brightbyte.ai)
3) If helpful, we can lock in a 14-day extension to your trial and add automated throttles at a spend cap.

Looping in Marissa (sales ops) and Laura (sales director) to approve credits and confirm billing/legal touchpoints.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

On Sun, Apr 18, 2027 at 09:12 AM, Hannah Lee wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo...
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: usage profile & budget range (BrightByte <> Redwood) — credit approval request

Aditya / Laura — quick internal note on the credit ask.

Policy context
- Standard trial top-up policy allows up to $5k for SDR/AE initiated pilot extensions without additional approvals. Anything above that needs Sales Director sign-off + Finance notification.
- We should require a short guardrail doc (trial-credit-approval-form.pdf) with: spend cap, automatic throttling threshold, and a go/no-go metric (e.g., Quality score >= 0.87 on evaluation set).

Recommendation
- Given the projected ramp and the potential 2M/day spike, recommend approving $7,500 instead of $5k. Tie that to the guardrails above and require procurement to sign PO intent within 21 days of the pilot top-up.

If you approve, I’ll prepare the trial-credit-approval-form and loop Finance. Also suggest we prepare a 30-minute technical onboarding slot with Solutions Eng to ensure they don’t spike inefficiently.

Marissa Cole
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: trial-credit-approval-form.pdf
From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brightbyte.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: usage profile & budget range (BrightByte <> Redwood) — credit & trial extension approved

Hannah — thanks for the clear summary and projection. We’ve reviewed internally and can move forward with the following:

Approved items
- Trial credit top-up: $7,500 granted to BrightByte account (BB-2027-049).
- Trial extension: 21 days added to the current pilot period starting 2027-04-19.
- Guardrails: spend cap and automatic throttling will be configured at the account level; we’ll cap at $8k total and throttle at 90% of that to avoid runaway spend.
- Evaluation gate: technical success + quality >= 0.87 required before we discuss committed pricing.

Pricing note
- For the pilot we’ll price at $400 / 1M tokens for the standard performance profile (as Aditya indicated). If BrightByte wants the latency-optimized profile at pilot time we can offer a blended pilot price; we’ll table that until they confirm which model they want to use at scale.

Operational next steps
1) Aditya: please confirm the HubSpot record and PO intent (HS-987654321).
2) Marissa: please send the trial-credit-approval-form and route to Finance.
3) Hannah: Let us know which model profile you want to run for weeks 1–3 so Solutions Eng can prep the onboarding slot.

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/HS-987654321
DocuSign for master MAA in process (link provided above).

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot running.

Laura Bennett
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0212
